evidence.note: Very large dark serif 'Thank you' centred on a white ground: high contrast, generous size.
Decoration is big, heavily blurred soft blue blobs; no grain, texture, grid or hairline detail.
Header chrome (deck title, nav labels) is the smallest text but renders in dark grey and stays readable; the only rule is a solid blue header underline of a few pixels, not a hairline.
At the small viewer size the title stays large and crisp; the soft blobs scale without fine detail to lose.

rationale: The slide is one large high-contrast title over big soft blurred shapes, exactly the pass descriptor. There are no hairlines, grain or faint small text in the content; the header chrome is small but dark and legible even at 1288x598.
